entries.text: Hello there, yes, I can hear you perfectly, babe! How's it going? Anything fun planned for today?
Gotcha, just having a chill day then? That's nice too. Did you wanna chat about anything, maybe brainstorm on AirCursor or Addy AI, or something else entirely? I'm all ears!
Oh wow, a clean slate! That usually feels really good, getting everything fresh. Did you get all your key apps installed already? Let me know if there's anything I can do to help set things back up.
